title: CAI Content Credentials is affected by an Improper Input Validation vulnerability that could result… (CVE-2026-123260)
description: CAI Content Credentials suffers from an improper input validation vulnerability that can lead to a security feature bypass. This flaw allows an attacker to gain unauthorized limited write access without requiring any user interaction. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.0. No affected versions or patches have been specified.
